zh-CN.title: 会话全文搜索
zh-CN.description: 检索历史消息正文，并跳转到命中的对话轮次。

usage.title: 打开工作区搜索
usage.description: 在侧边栏打开搜索，或使用 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 快捷键输入关键词。

usage.title: 按正文结果跳转
usage.description: 查看命中的消息摘录并点击结果，直接定位到对应会话和对话轮次。首次检索会自动建立当前账号的历史索引。

requirements: 管理员已安装并启用此扩展，配置 table_prefix 后重启 Gateway。

en-US.title: Conversation search
en-US.description: Search historical message text and jump to the matching conversation turn.

usage.title: Open workspace search
usage.description: Open Search from the sidebar or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K and enter your query.

usage.title: Jump to matching turns
usage.description: Inspect highlighted message excerpts and open a match to jump to that conversation turn. The first query starts an owner-scoped backfill index.

requirements: An administrator must install and enable this extension with table_prefix configured, then restart Gateway.
